SELECT member_number , member_name , member_phone_number , SUBSTR (resident_registration_number, 1, 6) AS birthDate , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(resident_registration_number, 7, 1) IN ('2','4','6','8') THEN '여' ELSE '남' END AS gender , account_status FROM member WHERE member_status = '환자'
AND ( member_name LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR member_phone_number LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
ORDER BY member_number

SELECT member_number AS memberNumber , member_id AS memberId , member_name AS memberName , member_phone_number AS memberPhoneNumber , SUBSTR(resident_registration_number,1,6) || '-' || SUBSTR(resident_registration_number,7,1) || '******' AS rrn , primary_address AS primaryAddress , detailed_address AS detailedAddress , postal_code AS postalCode , account_status AS accountStatus FROM member WHERE member_number = #{memberNumber} AND member_status = '환자'
